task: Surface the original network error code/message instead of a misleading HTTP 500 in codemie sdk CLI commands, fixing inside this repo.

key_reasoning.reason: The SDK ApiError drops axios code/cause, so a fix in handleSdkError alone cannot recover the original error. The fix needs a hook before the SDK interceptor (client factory in auth.ts) or a heuristic on the ApiError shape. No exact precedent, it depends on SDK internals (^0.1.648), and whether the axios instance is reachable is unverified.
